did: I built the pieces the two essays about the app needed, then drafted both. Commands now type themselves on screen in a new cheat-sheet version, and an essay can play a walk through the app in motion, the Rust Rounds week among them. The phone's pictures from Snips Capture showed "Asking home…" instead of the sample: the phone's pace stalled under the capture's frozen clock, and the capture never waited for reads it couldn't see, so it now waits for every screen to finish reading and lists one that never does rather than photographing it. Rendering the essays found two more faults, now fixed: no essay could show a screen of a nested route such as Renders, and the dashboard walks were recorded a screen taller than their pictures, which would have stretched them. Both essays, the "it didn't run" diagnosis and the Rust Rounds remake, are drafted from main's own capture and pass the cards check, and both render silently.

calls.title: Typed commands are a new terminal design, pinned by a new series version (C1425)
options: A new terminal design, terminal-v2, pinned by cheat-sheet v7, each line at the time v1 gives it
Change terminal-v1 in place, so every published essay types
calls.why: A design is frozen once a published video uses it, so typing had to be a new version an essay chooses.
calls.undo: Pin cheat-sheet v6 in an essay, or record a call that moves this one.

calls.title: A dashboard walk records a screen as tall as its tallest picture (WALK10, #3502)
options: The walk records its pictures' size, and the renderer never stretches a picture
Only loosen the essay recorder's shape check
Give every walk frame a size of its own in the walk schema
calls.why: The renderer stretched every picture to the walk's screen, so loosening the check alone would have squashed the rows, and a per-frame size would change a record home also reads.
calls.undo: Revert #3502; the dashboard walks then can't play in an essay until they record their rows' shape another way.

left: Both essays wait to go to paulgsc/testing until home runs release 1170's render image, after the owner's make home-deploy.
The Rust Rounds remake's opening spoken card plays three of the owner's takes, which home hands in at render; the silent render left that card out.
The diagnosis essay's Grafana chapter must be pointed at the fresh Snips Capture run on main after #3502, so the call dashboard's walk carries its row-shaped screen.
The capture's release pass still can't tell a screen that is reading, and its motion check's second picture isn't watched; both are named in #3495's tolerance.
Reading lines drawn other than as Reading (My data's Notice, game-week, the interview essay, skeletons) are still outside the capture's wait.
How the screen-zoom composition draws a shorter picture is held by no test, only by one end-to-end render.
